## Plot forecasts

### Example forecast

```{r}
plot_forecasts <- function(sid = "CA", n_week = 1, title = "a   1-week ahead forecast for California") {
  inci %>%
  dplyr::filter(state_id == sid,
                n == n_week) %>%
  mutate(forecast = ifelse(forecast >1500, 1500, forecast)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(y = forecast), point_interval = "mean_qi", .width = c(.95), 
                  color = "red", size = 1 / cm(1)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = incidence), color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~model, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Reds") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(y = "Weekly incidence (new cases per 100,000 people)",
       title = title) +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank())
}

for (sid in states) {
  sid_1week_pl <- plot_forecasts(toupper(sid), n_week = 1, title = paste("a   1-week ahead forecast for", state_names[sid]))
  sid_2week_pl <- plot_forecasts(toupper(sid), n_week = 2, title = paste("b   2-week ahead forecast for", state_names[sid]))
  sid_week_pl <- arrangeGrob(sid_1week_pl, sid_2week_pl, ncol = 2, widths = c(8,8))
  ggsave(paste0("results/example-forecast-", sid, ".pdf"), sid_week_pl, width = 16 / cm(1), height = 16 / cm(1))
}
```

```{r}
model_levels <- c("SARIMA", "Prophet", "GP", "DeepAR", "Chronos2")   # edit to match your labels

mcols <- c(
  SARIMA    = "#1f77b4",  # blue
  GP       = "#ff7f0e",  # orange
  Prophet  = "#2ca02c",  # green

  DeepAR = "#d62728"   # red

set.seed(123)

pit_from_quantile_vector <- function(q_vec, y, alphas = alpha_levels, randomized = TRUE) {
  q <- as.numeric(q_vec)
  # drop NAs and keep alphas aligned
  keep <- !is.na(q)
  q <- q[keep]
  alphas <- alphas[keep]

  # if nothing usable, return NA
  if (length(q) == 0L) {
    print("nothing usable")
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  o <- order(alphas)
  alphas <- alphas[o]; q <- q[o]
  q <- cummax(q)

  if (!is.na(y) && y < q[1]) {
    return(if (randomized) runif(1, 0, alphas[1]) else 0)
  }
  if (!is.na(y) && y > tail(q, 1)) {
    return(if (randomized) runif(1, tail(alphas, 1), 1) else 1)
  }

  iu <- which(q >= y)[1]
  if (is.na(iu)) return(NA_real_)  # safety

  il <- max(1, iu - 1)
  ql <- q[il]; qu <- q[iu]; al <- alphas[il]; au <- alphas[iu]

  if (qu > ql) {
    al + (au - al) * (y - ql) / (qu - ql)
  } else {
    if (randomized) runif(1, al, au) else (al + au) / 2
  }
}

pCalib_all <- inci %>%

    } else {
```

### Empirical coverage

```{r}
quantile_coverage <- function(qvec, y, q_level, alphas = alpha_levels){
  y  <- y[1]                              # one observed value per group
  qv <- as.numeric(qvec)                  # the 17 quantiles
  a  <- as.numeric(alphas)

  ok <- !is.na(qv)
  qv <- qv[ok]; a <- a[ok]
  if (length(qv) == 0L || is.na(y)) return(NA_real_)

  il <- which.min(abs(a - q_level))
  iu <- which.min(abs(a - (1 - q_level)))

  ql <- qv[il]
  qu <- qv[iu]

  as.integer(!is.na(ql) && !is.na(qu) && y >= ql && y <= qu)
}

cov90 <- inci %>%
  group_by(state_id, date, n, model) %>%
  summarize(
    cov = if (first(model) %in% quantile_models){
      quantile_coverage(forecast, incidence, q_level = 0.05)}
          else{
            out <- pred_score(forecast, incidence, type = "coverage", q = 0.05)
            as.numeric(out[1])},
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  summarize(cov = mean(cov, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(n = ordered(paste0(n, "-week ahead forecast")))

cov90_pl <- cov90 %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(n), y = cov, color = model, group = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = .9), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0, 1), labels = function(x) x * 100) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mcols) +
  labs(y = "Coverage of 90%-PI (%)") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank())
```

### Sharpness

```{r}
quantile_sharpness <- function(qvec, alphas = alpha_levels) {
  q <- as.numeric(qvec); a <- as.numeric(alphas)
  ok <- !is.na(q); q <- q[ok]; a <- a[ok]
  if (!length(q)) return(NA_real_)
  # pick the exact 0.25 and 0.75 (they exist in your grid)
  q25 <- q[which.min(abs(a - 0.25))]
  q75 <- q[which.min(abs(a - 0.75))]
  0.5 * (q75 - q25)     # ~MAD scale
}

# compute sharpness score
sharp <- inci %>%
  group_by(state_id, date, n, model) %>%
  summarize(
    sh = if (first(model) %in% quantile_models)
           quantile_sharpness(forecast)
         else
           pred_score(forecast, type = "sharpness"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  summarize(sh = mean(sh, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(n = ordered(paste0(n, "-week ahead forecast")))

# plot sharpness
sharp_pl <- sharp %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(n), y = sh, color = model, group = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mcols) +
  labs(y = "Dispersion") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank())

sharp_pl
```


### Overestimation

```{r}
cdf_from_quantiles <- function(qvec, y, alphas = alpha_levels) {
  y  <- y[1]
  qv <- as.numeric(qvec); a <- as.numeric(alphas)
  ok <- !is.na(qv); qv <- qv[ok]; a <- a[ok]
  if (length(qv) == 0L || is.na(y)) return(NA_real_)
  
  o <- order(a); a <- a[o]; qv <- cummax(qv[o])
  m <- length(qv)

  # below first / above last: use midpoint of the adjacent CDF interval
  if (y < qv[1])      return(a[1] / 2)             # E[Unif(0, a1)]
  if (y > qv[m])      return((a[m] + 1) / 2)       # E[Unif(am, 1)]
  iu <- which(qv >= y)[1]
  il <- max(1, iu - 1)
  ql <- qv[il]; qu <- qv[iu]; al <- a[il]; au <- a[iu]

  if (qu > ql) {
    # linear interpolation between adjacent quantiles
    al + (au - al) * (y - ql) / (qu - ql)
  } else {
    # flat segment: midpoint of CDF interval
    (al + au) / 2
  }
}

# compute bias
bias <- inci %>%
  group_by(state_id, date, n, model) %>%
  summarize(b = pred_score(forecast, incidence, type = "bias")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  summarize(b = mean(b, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(n = ordered(paste0(n, "-week ahead forecast"))) 


# plot bias
bias_pl <- bias %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(n), y = b, color = model, group = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 0.5), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)), labels = function(x) x * 100) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mcols) +
  labs(y = "Overestimation (%)") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(), axis.title.x = element_blank())

bias_pl
```

```{r}
# -------- CRPS table (short headers) + clean side-by-side export --------
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gridExtra)

library(readr)

outdir <- "results/crps"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1) mean CRPS per model × horizon
score_col <- if ("crps" %in% names(crps)) "crps" else "CRPS"

crps_table <- crps %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  summarize(mean_crps = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(horizon = n) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, horizon, mean_crps) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = horizon, values_from = mean_crps) %>%
  arrange(model)

# Shorten headers: "1 wk forecast", "2 wk forecast"

# Save raw numbers
readr::write_csv(crps_table, file.path(outdir, "crps_table.csv"))

# Display (rounded strings for tidy alignment)
crps_table_disp <- crps_table %>%
  mutate(across(-model, ~ sprintf("%.2f", .x)))

# 2) Table grob (smaller font + padding) with solid border
tbl_theme <- gridExtra::ttheme_default(
  core   = list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.85, col = "black"),  padding = unit(c(5,7), "pt")),
  colhead= list(fg_params = list(cex = 0.9,  fontface = "bold"), padding = unit(c(6,8), "pt"))
```

#### Quantile models
```{r}
source("utils/eval.r")

# 2) helper to get one quantile vector per group
get_qvec <- function(forecast_vec, draw_vec, model) {
  if (model %in% quantile_models) {
    # Quantile-only models: forecasts already *are* quantiles.
    # Use draw order if available to keep the intended order.
    if (!is.null(draw_vec)) {
      v <- forecast_vec[order(draw_vec)]
    } else {
      v <- forecast_vec
    }
    # Ensure we return exactly length(alpha_levels)
    v <- as.numeric(v)
    stopifnot(length(v) >= length(alpha_levels))
    v[seq_along(alpha_levels)]
  } else {
    # Sample-based models: convert draws -> quantiles on the common grid
    as.numeric(stats::quantile(as.numeric(forecast_vec),
                               probs = alpha_levels, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE, type = 7))
  }
}

# 3) compute WIS (one value per group), then average by horizon & model
wis_raw <- inci %>%
  group_by(state_id, date, n, model) %>%
  summarize(
    obs  = first(incidence),
    qvec = list(get_qvec(forecast_vec = forecast,
                         draw_vec = if ("draw" %in% names(dplyr::cur_data())) draw else NULL,
                         model = first(model))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # call pred_score with quantiles + alphas
  dplyr::mutate(WIS = map2_dbl(qvec, obs, ~ pred_score(x = .x, y = .y, type = "wis", alphas = alpha_levels))) %>%
  dplyr::select(-qvec, -obs)

wis <- wis_raw%>%
  dplyr::group_by(n, model) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(WIS = mean(WIS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n = ordered(paste0(n, "-week ahead forecast")))

wis_pl <- wis %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(n), y = WIS, color = model, group = model)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(shape = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mcols) +        # keep your palette
  labs(x = NULL, y = "WIS (lower is better)") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

wis_pl
ggsave("results/WIS.pdf", wis_pl, width = 16 / cm(1), height = 6 / cm(1))
```

```{r}
# 20 empirical quantiles (0.05,...,0.95)
emp_probs <- seq(0.05, 0.95, by = 0.05)

# wis_raw must have: state_id, date, n, model, WIS  (from earlier step)
wis_qdots <- wis_raw %>%
  filter(is.finite(WIS)) %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  summarize(
    q_vals = list(as.numeric(stats::quantile(WIS, probs = emp_probs, na.rm = TRUE))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prob = list(emp_probs)) %>%
  unnest(c(q_vals, prob)) %>%
  mutate(
    n_lab = ordered(paste0(n, "-week ahead forecast")),
    model = factor(model, c("EpiEstim","EpiNow2","SARIMA","DeepAR","GP","Chronos2"))
  )

wis_summ <- wis_raw %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_wis   = mean(WIS, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_wis = median(WIS, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    n_lab = ordered(paste0(n, "-week ahead forecast")),
    model = factor(model, c("EpiEstim","EpiNow2","SARIMA","DeepAR","GP","Chronos2"))
  )

wis_q_pl <- ggplot(wis_qdots, aes(x = q_vals, y = model, color = model)) +
  # Slight vertical offset by quantile
  geom_point(aes(y = as.numeric(model) + (prob - 0.5) * 0.5),
             size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Mean (blue diamond)
  geom_point(data = wis_summ, aes(x = mean_wis, y = as.numeric(model)),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 23, size = 3.2,
             color = "royalblue", fill = "white", stroke = 1) +
  
  # Median (black circle)
  geom_point(data = wis_summ, aes(x = median_wis, y = as.numeric(model)),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21, size = 2.6,
             color = "black", fill = "white", stroke = 0.8) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ n_lab, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:length(levels(wis_qdots$model)),
    labels = levels(wis_qdots$model)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mcols) +
  labs(x = "WIS (lower is better)", y = NULL, title = "WIS scores (20 empirical quantiles)") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )

wis_q_pl
```

### ... by phase

```{r}
# summarize crps by phase
crps_by_phase <- crps %>%
  left_join(phase_labs %>% 
              dplyr::select(-start_date, -end_date) %>% 
              rename(state_id = state)) %>%
  mutate(epidemic_phase = recode(as.character(epidemic_phase), !!! phase_names_abrv2)) %>%
  mutate(epidemic_phase = factor(epidemic_phase, levels = phase_names_abrv2)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(epidemic_phase))

crps_by_phase_sum <- crps_by_phase %>%
  group_by(epidemic_phase, n, model) %>%
  summarize(Median = median(crps)) %>%
  ungroup() 

# plot crps by phase
crps_by_phase_pl <- crps_by_phase_sum %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Median, fill = model)) +
  facet_wrap(~ epidemic_phase, ncol = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mcols) +
  labs(y = "Median CRPS") +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge2()) +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

crps_by_phase_pl 
save_plot(crps_by_phase_pl, "results/crps_by_phase.pdf", w = 16, h = 10)
```

### Pairwise comparisons

```{r}
# compute pairwise comparisons
pwc <- pairwise_comparison(crps, by = c("n", "model"))

# relative skill
rel_skill_pl <- pwc %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(model, relative_skill), x = relative_skill, fill = model)) +
  facet_wrap(~ n) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mcols) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Relative skill", title = "b   Pairwise model comparison") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.spacing = unit(.5, "lines"),
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5, 7.5, 5.5, 5.5), "points"))

rel_skill_pl

# significance
score_ratio_comp_pl <- pwc %>%
  filter(model == "GP",
         compare_against != "GP") %>%
  mutate(adj_pval = ifelse(adj_pval < 0.01, "p<0.01", paste0("p=", round(adj_pval, 2)))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = reorder(compare_against, mean_scores_ratio), x = mean_scores_ratio, fill = compare_against)) +
  facet_wrap(~ n) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = adj_pval), size = 8 / cm(1), hjust = -.1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mcols) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.55))) +
  labs(x = "Mean score ratio", title = "c   GP compared against...") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        panel.spacing = unit(.5, "lines"))

score_ratio_comp_pl

crps_and_pairwise_pl <- arrangeGrob(crps_pl, arrangeGrob(rel_skill_pl, score_ratio_comp_pl, ncol = 2, widths = c(7.5, 8.5)), nrow = 2, heights = c(10, 6))
ggsave("results/crps_pairwise.pdf", crps_and_pairwise_pl, width = 16 / cm(1), height = 16 / cm(1))
```


### Hotspot prediction

```{r}
# compute hotspot probabilities
hotspot <- inci %>%
  group_by(state_id, draw, n, model) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(is_hotspot = ifelse(incidence / dplyr::lag(incidence, 1) - 1 > 0.25, T, F),
         pred_hotspot = ifelse(forecast / dplyr::lag(forecast, 1) - 1 > 0.25, T, F)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(state_id, n, model, date) %>%
  summarize(incidence = incidence[1], 
            is_hotspot = is_hotspot[1],
            p_hotspot = sum(pred_hotspot) / n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(n = ordered(paste0(n, "-week ahead forecast"))) 

hotspot_filt <- hotspot %>%
  dplyr::filter(incidence >= 70) 

nrow(hotspot_filt) / nrow(hotspot)
sum(hotspot_filt$is_hotspot, na.rm = T) / nrow(hotspot_filt)

hotspot_rocs <- hotspot_filt %>%
  mutate(is_hotspot = factor(ifelse(is_hotspot, "Yes", "No"), levels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
  group_by(n, model) %>%
  summarize(rocs = list(roc(is_hotspot, p_hotspot))) %>%
  ungroup()

hotspot_rocs_pl <- hotspot_rocs %>%
  mutate(sens = lapply(rocs, function(r) r$sensitivities),
         spec = lapply(rocs, function(r) r$specificities)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-rocs) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(sens, spec)) %>%
  mutate(inv_spec = 1 - spec) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = inv_spec, y = sens, color = model)) +
  facet_wrap(~n) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_abline(aes(intercept = 0, slope = 1), alpha = .5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), labels = function(x) x * 100) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), labels = function(x) x * 100) +
  scale_color_manual(values = mcols) +
  labs(x = "1 - Specificity (%)", y = "Sensitivity (%)") +
  theme_bw2() +
  theme(legend.position = c(.9, .2), legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
        plot.margin = unit(c(5.5, 7.5, 5.5, 5.5), "points"),
        legend.key.size = unit(.2, "cm"))

hotspot_rocs_pl

hotspot_aucs <- hotspot_rocs %>%
  mutate(auc = sapply(rocs, function(r) r$auc)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-rocs) %>%
  mutate(auc = round(100 * auc)) %>%
  dcast(model ~ n) %>%
  set_names(c("Model", "1-week AUC", "2-week AUC"))

tt <- ttheme_default(colhead=list(fg_params = list(parse=TRUE)),
                     base_size = 8,
                     padding = unit(c(2, 4), "mm"))
auc_tbl <- tableGrob(hotspot_aucs, rows=NULL, theme = tt)

hotspot_roc_auc_pl <- arrangeGrob(hotspot_rocs_pl, auc_tbl, ncol = 2, widths = c(10, 6))
ggsave("results/hotspot.pdf", hotspot_roc_auc_pl, width = 16 / cm(1), height = 6 / cm(1))
```
